correctness.rationale: PASS: For T and W, ambient entrywise dot products give H=[A J;J A], A(t,u)=psi(tu+(tu)^(-1)), J all ones. Multiplicative characters take v_chi to K_chi v_chi^{-1}; two-copy symmetric/antisymmetric decomposition gives exceptional |K_1±(p-1)| and double |K_chi| for nontrivial chi. Over E=Q(mu_(p-1)), Phi_p is irreducible, so a zero K_chi would force all trace-fiber coefficient sums c_s equal, contradicting c_2=1 and some c_s=0. Equality in triangle inequality excludes K_1=±(p-1), and characteristic 2 yields rank one. Weil bounds ensure separated exceptional levels for p>=19. Independent full complex SVD vs character formula checked p=2,3,5,7,11 and both nonzero b values for odd p; finite checks support the proof.
